name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Operator UX reduced to a simple flow: select Groups, choose 10/15/20/25 posts per Group, press QUÉT.
QUÉT NHÓM column I is now validated to 10/15/20/25; legacy values outside the range are normalized to 25.
Visible operator columns W:Z are Chọn, Trạng thái, Tiến độ, Lỗi/Ghi chú.
Control Center shows counters for selected Groups, requested posts, running, completed, errors, incomplete/stopped.
Adds RETRY for LỖI and THIẾU groups.
Group API scanning now paginates by cursor until the requested target is reached, cursor is exhausted, stop is requested, or the per-group time budget is reached.
If Social AIO returns fewer posts than requested and no usable cursor, the row is marked THIẾU rather than XONG.
Technical Import JSON, AI and API Bridge settings are collapsed under Advanced; day-to-day operation stays at the top.
